expectations: okay-pm runs
Lists the inbox issues needing triage, oldest first, and lets the user pick

description: Chinese request for what to work on next
prompt: 下一批该做哪些 issue？帮我排一下优先级
expectations: okay-pm runs in plan mode

description: Status update request without the skill name
prompt: Post a project status update for this week: what shipped and what is next
expectations: okay-pm runs in status mode

description: Inbox grooming request in plain words
prompt: Go through the new bug reports in Linear and tell me which ones are ready for an agent
expectations: okay-pm runs in triage mode

description: Implementing a ticket belongs to okay-dev
prompt: Implement TON-12, the retry logic for the export job
expectations: okay-pm does not run

description: A small bug fix belongs to okay-fix
prompt: formatPrice(0) returns an empty string, please fix it
expectations: okay-pm does not run

description: A recurring digest is a Linear Loop, not a scheduled okay-pm run
prompt: Send me a status digest every Monday morning
expectations: okay-pm does not schedule anything
Tells the user to set up a Linear Loop

description: Triage a bug: reproduce, check redundancy, brief with disclaimer
prompt: /okay-pm triage TON-31 (reporter says the CSV export drops the last row)
expectations: Loads the Linear tools by suffix with ToolSearch before using them
Searches the code for an existing implementation or fix before recommending a state
Reproduces the bug with a real command and reports confirmed, failed, or insufficient detail
States category and state with evidence and waits for the user before writing
Every comment posted starts with the line: > *This was generated by AI during triage.*
For ready-for-agent posts an agent brief with acceptance criteria and sets the label and status Todo
Does not write the fix

description: Plan: frontier ranked by priority, batch with tiers and lanes
expectations: Lists only open, unassigned issues whose blockers are all completed or canceled
Ranks by priority, one line per issue, at most 5 lines shown
Does not put an issue without ready-for-agent into the batch
Gives each batch item a lane and a model tier with effort taken from the shared tables
Writes nothing to Linear
Ends with one next action

description: Status: health, merged PRs only, posted as a project status update
expectations: Counts an issue as shipped only when its linked PR is confirmed merged
Chooses onTrack, atRisk, or offTrack and gives a one-line reason
Shows the draft before posting
Posts with save_status_update as a project update, not as an issue comment
Does not create any schedule; points to a Linear Loop for recurring digests

prompt: /okay-pm triage (the current repo matches a contributor pattern in ~/.claude/okay.local.md)
expectations: Says in one line that okay-pm does not run in contributor mode
Creates no issue, comment, label, or status update
Writes no file in the repo

description: No Linear connector: fall back to GitHub issues and say so
prompt: /okay-pm plan (the Linear connector is not available in this session)
expectations: ToolSearch finds no save_issue and okay-pm says in one line that it uses GitHub issues
Finds the frontier with gh issue list, treating a Blocked by line as a blocker
Writes nothing
